order: row-major: the last joint varies fastest; flat = ravel_multi_index(indices, shape)
margin_rule: a pose is forbidden when an arm geom comes closer than margin_m to a rover part; MuJoCo's geom margin is set on the rover parts only

stand_ins.rule: per rover mesh: the share of its sampled surface lying more than cover_tol_m outside the parts that count as they are, the extent of that share in the rover frame (m), and the boxes standing in for it

root_link.rule: its meshes as surface stand-ins, its own joints sampled every step_deg; a contact closer than margin_m forbids every grid value within half a grid step

mount_rule: the root link touches these at every value of its joints: those contacts are not counted
part_counts_rule: cells where the arm touches this part (a cell counts for every part it touches)
joint_map_rule: rad = sign * (ticks - model_zero_ticks) * 2 pi / ticks_per_rev; ticks as the servo reports them (homing offset applied); align with two poses (docs/arm.md)
occupancy_rule: occupancy: one uint8 per cell, 1 = forbidden, flat in row-major order, packed 8 cells per byte (numpy packbits, first cell in the high bit), written in hex
cell_part_rule: 0 = free, k = part_names[k - 1]: the rover part with the most contacts in that cell
